title: Technology Sector Update for 05/22/2018: RDCM,FEYE
text:

Technology stocks still were firming Tuesday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding about 0.1% in value while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was posting a more than 0.8% gain.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Radcom ( RDCM ) was trading about 2.5% higher Tuesday afternoon, giving back roughly two-thirds of a more than 7% advance earlier in the session that followed the service assurance and customer experience software company reporting improved non-GAAP Q1 net income and revenue exceeding year-ago levels and also beating analyst estimates. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.07 per share during the three months ended March 31, up from $0.02 per share during the same quarter last year and beating the two-analyst mean looking for adjusted net income of $0.00 per share. Revenue rose 36.3% year over year to $10.9 million, up from $8 million during the year-ago period and topping the $9.6 million Street view.
In other sector news:
- FireEye ( FEYE ) was sliding almost 2% lower Tuesday afternoon, retracing most of a 2.3% decline for the cycbersecurity company's stock that followed it pricing a $525 million private placement of 0.875% convertible senior notes due 2024 for eligible purchasers. The company expects to spend a portion of the net proceeds to fund selected capped-call transactions and buy back around $340.2 million of its 1% convertible senior notes due 2035 with any remaining funds to be used for general corporate purposes.
